items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: and then I worked with another band called Danny Williams.

ctx.x: No, no, not at all. Because his music was -- it was the same thing, different. Completely different. He had another kind of an imagination, you know? Oh, getting back to him, what I -- I'm trying to pull these things together. Fambro and the other guys, after we'd been together for awhile, and then I worked with another band called Danny Williams. It was a local band in Chicago. Didn't have the same thing that I wanted to associate with that Tony Fambro had, you know? And that's the band that I went to Kentucky…
Well, which came first, Tony[Fambro's] band went to --
